text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Time to head to the usual ramen 
shop—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? What's with this line!? It's 
usually completely empty at this hour!?

text_block_list.name: People in Line
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta fuel up before a live performance!" 
"I'm so glad we found a good ramen shop 
nearby~"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...!? Oh no! Today was the day of an event 
nearby...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! And here I thought I put together 
the most time-efficient schedule ever...!
